concept_options.title: Light bent by rain
concept_options.hook: Why does a rainbow always arc the same way?
concept_options.why_this_works: Grounded in refraction and dispersion physics from the research brief.

concept_options.title: Forty-two degrees
concept_options.hook: It is always the same angle, no matter where you stand.
concept_options.visual_approach: Geometric diagram of the cone of returned light
concept_options.why_this_works: The fixed geometry is memorable and counterintuitive.

concept_options.title: A spectrum walk
concept_options.hook: Each color bends by its own amount.
concept_options.visual_approach: Continuous spectral sweep across a dark backdrop
concept_options.why_this_works: The spectrum is intrinsically visual and satisfying.

selected_concept.rationale: Most directly grounded in the researched physics; visuals are achievable with chained I2V.

tools.role: Chained I2V clips for each scene

stages.approach: Generate T2I2V clips per scene, chaining when a scene exceeds 8s so real motion covers the full planned duration.
